test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The scene of Ratan’s friend’s bike accident remains __stamped__ in his memory.
solution:
The correct answer is **imprinted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **most appropriate** synonym for the given word '**stamped**' is '**imprinted**'.
